create_target_encoder_regression: create a TargetEncoder to encode categorical features for regression with auto-smoothing
fit_transform_target_encoder_classificat: fit_transform a TargetEncoder on binary classification data with cross-fitting to prevent target leakage
transform_target_encoder_test_data: transform unseen test data using a fitted TargetEncoder with unknown category handling
create_multiclass_target_encoder: create a TargetEncoder with multiclass target type to encode categories per class using one-vs-all binarization
get_feature_names_out_target_encoder: get_feature_names_out from a fitted TargetEncoder to retrieve encoded feature names
